score.line: Hand this list to your office manager.

reasons: Second rerun on the new sheets and gate pack after a design re-render (gauge, inventory, receipt); same transcript, send card unchanged.
1. I own a small HVAC shop (the lesson's example trade). I would send it to the office manager who answers our phones and does the billing.
2. "Hand this list to your office manager." then "Write down how we answer a call, price a job, book the work and send the bill, one page each."
3. Helps: it gives her a four-item job she can start this week and shows her work is what makes the shop worth more than me.
4. Surprise: "She isn't buying you." flips what the owner thinks a buyer pays for. The new EVERY ANSWER: YOU line at 12.5s to 15.5s sets it up more clearly.
5. Thanks: a plan that puts her at the center, not a lecture; the 2.73x ACHR News number, now a clean 2.73x ANNUAL EARNINGS FLORIDA HVAC, 2025 card from 47.0s, gives it weight.
6. End card reads "Send this to your office manager this week." It points at the person I named.
7. The FOR YOUR OFFICE MANAGER card is unchanged, still and readable from about 24.5s to 34.0s (sheet f09 at 24.81s is clean). Only the item highlight moves.
8. The voice and the card header both name the office manager.

Minor, not blocking (carried over): during the hold only the active item is dark and the rest stay grey, so a mid-hold screenshot has uneven contrast. Fix: set all four items full dark for the last second before 34.0s.
